blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Jordan Murphy will look to play a major role in Barangay Ginebra’s bid to avoid a collapse and beat San Miguel Beer in the deciding fifth game of their PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series on Tuesday at Ynares Center in Antipolo. A trip to the semifinals and a best-of-five duel with TNT will be at stake in the decider, which was pushed by the Beermen after battling back from a 0-2 deficit by winning back-to-back games. That included Friday’s 108-102 win at Smart Araneta Coliseum, which saw the Gin Kings squander a 17-point third-quarter lead while the Beermen held Murphy […]...
